mapper.sql: id, order_id, order_no, user_id, activity_id, product_id, sku_id, product_name, product_image, spec_desc, seckill_price, quantity, request_id, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT so.id, so.order_id, so.order_no, so.user_id, so.activity_id, so.product_id, so.sku_id, so.product_name, so.product_image, so.spec_desc, so.seckill_price, so.quantity, so.request_id, so.created_at, so.updated_at, o.status AS order_status, o.total_amount, o.pay_amount, a.activity_name FROM mall_seckill_order so LEFT JOIN mall_order o ON o.id = so.order_id LEFT JOIN mall_seckill_activity a ON a.id = so.activity_id WHERE so.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY so.created_at DESC
